Named versions travel with the folder; machine-local operation journals stay on the computer where they were recorded. PPTX already contains slide parts too; HUANDENG exposes an accessible working folder. The new entry flow accepts a PPTD or a folder containing exactly one PPTD. A descriptive folder suffix is optional. If the folder has several entries, choose the intended file explicitly."

designIntent.purpose: The PPTD file is the entry; the directory is the complete project
keep: Keep actual product captures, original scientific data/assets, attribution and the demonstrated function. Do not fragment ordinary prose into a fake table.
designIntent.requestedChange: Explain the product and its use; interpret the founder’s account to choose the emphasis.
